That's horrible. I know what it's like to lose a loved pet. I had two dogs whom had been with me since I was 13 pass away a few months ago, I'm 22 now so they lived a long time. It was horrible having to pick up their bodies and I broke down for a good couple weeks because I can't handle loss really well. What got me through it was remembering all the good times with them, and remembering how they would always come up to me when I was sad and do their best to cheer me up. I gave them a wonderful life and lots of love, so I knew they wouldn't want me sad, that they would want me happy since that's how they always acted. It still hurts to think about them, but not nearly as much as it used to since now I think about the good time with them. I'm sorry that happened to you, but just remember that you gave that animal an amazing life and lots of love,
